packet.title: Sweep: 7.11's open cases and the larger duplicates (implementation)

item.p: Cases: XT40 transform-004 (a static fn:transform, FOXT0004), transform-401 (a ~record pattern), transform-009 (an assertion the XT40 driver did not check). Close 7.11's gate, or record exactly why a case cannot pass under the project's draft.

Duplicates (, ): the three UTF-8 and UTF-16 decoders; Full Text reading through the resolver itself; the private growable arrays; the schema reader's boolean and integer parsers; Gregorian day arithmetic; compile-report text; the text form writers; the serialization heapsorts.

Size: the core stays under budget (the guard). Done 2026-10-20 (): XT40 transform 10 of 12. transform-009 passes, and so do five result-document cases: the driver checks assert-serialization inside assert-result-document on the serialized result document. transform-004 cannot pass while holds: compiling a static fn:transform re-enters the compiler. transform-401 needs the newest draft's "~T" patterns: targets that draft, and packet 4.22 brings them. Merged: one decoder with an error rule, Full Text through sxml_optional_feature_read_data, sxml_allocator_reserve_array, the cast engine's boolean and digits, cycle days in src/calendar.c, compile reports built in one place, src/text_form.c, and sxml_sort_in_place for the serialization sorts. XT40 11,945 to 11,951 passed; XP40, XQ40 and XSD unchanged; sxml.wasm 2,089,167 (guard +345).
